literal: Even towards those of the character of doing harm, showing consideration and practicing endurance is the supreme quality.
translation: Even towards those whose nature is to cause harm, showing consideration and practicing forgiveness is the supreme virtue.
modern: துன்பம் செய்யும் குணம் உடையவர்களிடத்தும் இரக்கம் காட்டி, அத்துன்பத்தைப் பொறுத்துக் கொள்ளும் பண்பே மிகச் சிறந்ததாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the ultimate expression of 'kaṇṇōṭṭam' (benignity or consideration). The poet states that it is easy to be kind to those who are good, but the supreme virtue lies in showing consideration even to those whose very nature is to cause harm. Instead of retaliating, one must look upon them with a kindly eye and endure their actions with patience. This noble quality of combining consideration with forgiveness is hailed as the highest of all virtues.
